questions.prompt: A reply asks for read a.txt, then bash, then read b.txt. How does the scheduler group them?
options: All three together, because two of them are reads
read a.txt alone, then bash alone, then read b.txt alone
Both reads together first, then bash
bash first, because it takes longest
questions.explanation: Groups follow model order. bash is not safe, so it ends the first group and runs alone; the read after it starts a new group.

questions.prompt: A tool's isConcurrencySafe throws an error for one call. What does the scheduler do?
options: It runs the call with the others
questions.explanation: Only the exact value true means safe. A thrown error counts as not safe, so the call runs alone.

questions.prompt: read b.txt finishes before read a.txt in the same group. In what order does the model get the results?
options: b.txt first, because it finished first
a.txt first, because results keep the order of the calls
Only the first one to finish
questions.explanation: Promise.all returns results in call order, so the record and the model always see them in the order the model asked.
